headline: Analysts expect weak growth from India's big IT services firms this quarter, partly because AI is making their traditional work cheaper.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: an earnings preview with analyst views on India's IT services firms, not yet results.
importance_line: Staff and investors at Indian IT services firms face slow growth and pricing pressure, as AI lets clients get the same work done for less; the figures are analysts' expectations, not results.
summary: BusinessLine reports that analysts expect India's top IT services companies to show muted growth for the July-September quarter, with research firm UnearthInsight forecasting 0.5 to 1 per cent growth from the previous quarter for the top five. Analysts at UnearthInsight and Gartner say clients keep discretionary budgets tight and that AI is lowering the price of traditional services, with Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) due to report first on 8 Oct.
notes: Preview of company results due from 8 Oct 2026 (TCS), HCLTech 12 Oct, Infosys 23 Oct. Figures are analyst forecasts.
